model_interpretation.claim: Hoisting row bases and applying a compile-gated OpenMP SIMD hint to the contiguous-x loop may help the compiler vectorize the radius-3 update when its OpenMP support is available. The ordinary loop remains as a fallback; no target ISA, row alignment, or fixed vector width is assumed. Measure both core budgets, including setup costs, and validate the fixed tolerance before drawing conclusions.

items.objective: Optimize the contiguous-x radius-3 update, contrasting a compiler-vectorizable loop with explicit SIMD only when supported by the frozen target configuration. Do not change compiler settings or assume row alignment; handle tails and generic n. Preserve the recurrence, full initialization, and boundaries, and validate the fixed tolerance. Measure both core budgets and include any setup costs.
